plugin.name: json_render
plugin.description: json-render catalog projection — schema, specs, catalogs, renderers, actions, validation, and upstream API inventory

actions.description: Built-in runtime actions exposed by the React action provider.

components.description: Catalog component declarations from the shadcn catalog exemplar.

config.description: Local policy for exposing json-render through D-Bus projections.

core_exports.description: Core exported functions and schemas available to hosts.

methods.description: D-Bus method declarations exported by this plugin.

packages.description: Package inventory observed from the upstream workspace.

renderers.description: Renderer packages and their host integration surfaces.

source.description: Source authority used to define this projection.

spec_contract.description: Flat UI tree contract used by json-render specs.

status.description: Operational status of the catalog projection.

validation_checks.description: Validation checks built into the core validation module.

package.description: Package or module that owns this symbol.

default_renderer.description: Default renderer target for UI projection previews.

expose_catalog.description: Allow catalog metadata to be exposed through D-Bus.

expose_prompt_surface.description: Allow prompt-building metadata to be exposed through D-Bus.

role.description: Package role in the json-render system.

commit.description: Upstream commit inspected for package and API inventory.

subid.description: Stable OSCAL subid for the method.

element_fields.description: UI element fields recognized by core.

patch_ops.description: Supported JSON Patch operations for streaming edits.
